gcPauseMs.how: V8's mark-compact cycles in the pass: 6.9 ms (incremental 0.3 ms, major 6.7 ms) over 1 cycles, a mean of 6.946 ms (the model's median: mean / 1.17); 231 scavenges, 236.0 ms, left in the CPU per request

writeServiceTimeMs.how: PostgreSQL's CPU per INSERT (0.3010 ms), shaped like the consumer's INSERT less its commit wait (median 1.695 - 1.028 ms, p95 2.971 - 1.028 ms)

dbLinkLatencyMs.how: each way: the round trip the service measured less PostgreSQL's time, in two legs that keep its mean and variance (median 0.1447, p95 0.8657 ms)

dbCpuShare.how: PostgreSQL CPU per query at the top pass net of idle (0.3010 ms) / the model's mean time per query (the INSERT, 0.301 ms)
